typography.notes: Use tabular-nums for ALL numeric values (carats, loss %). Line height tight for headers, relaxed for body. Do not use generic fonts for headers.

colors.notes: Swiss High-Contrast archetype. 95% monochrome. Color exists only to guide action or indicate loss/success. Tint grey with subtle warmth to suit the Polki/Diamond domain.

visual_enhancers.surfaces: Neumorphism (The Tactile Variant) for dashboard widgets: mix soft shadows with sharp 1px inner contrasts (border-black/5).
visual_enhancers.data_tables: Grid Borders (Technical Look): Expose the skeleton. border-collapse style with subtle right/bottom borders for each cell.
visual_enhancers.forms: Inputs should have 1px solid borders, focused state must have higher contrast (ring-2 ring-primary).
visual_enhancers.print: Use @media print to hide navigation, sidebars, and actions. Ensure Jangad slip uses strict black-and-white, high-contrast, compact grid.

components.navigation: Sticky sidebar or top nav with Glassmorphism (backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/70) if content scrolls under, or Solid Background with hard bottom border. Never fully transparent.
components.tables: Shadcn UI tables. Right-align all numeric columns. Use tabular-nums. Include bulk-action affordance.
components.buttons: Sharp rectangular with interaction animations (hover:bg-primary/90 hover:text-white).
components.inputs: Shadcn UI inputs. Generous spacing (p-6) in form wrappers, but dense inside.
components.charts: Shadcn chart components (Recharts). Use horizontal bars for loss comparisons. Avoid pie charts.

grids_layouts.dashboard: Bento Grid Protocol: High Density Grid (cols-1 md:cols-4). Tight gaps (gap-4). Every pixel utilized.
grids_layouts.mobile: Mobile-first standard full-width stacked inputs. Tables should have horizontal scroll on mobile with a frozen first column.
grids_layouts.forms: Multi-column grids on desktop (md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-4) for data entry to reduce vertical scroll and keep related numeric fields close.

motion.interactions: Hover states on all interactive elements. Slight lift (-translate-y-1) on cards. Micro-animations for feedback.
motion.transitions: Use specific properties (transition-transform, transition-colors), NEVER transition-all.

accessibility.contrast: Minimum 4.5:1 for normal text. Explicitly set text color on hover. Focus states must have higher contrast.
accessibility.testing: All interactive elements MUST include data-testid attribute (e.g., data-testid='login-submit-button').
accessibility.screen_readers: Native table markup for data tables.

media.icons: Phosphor Icons (@phosphor-icons/react) for dense dashboard and developer tool look.

images.description: Jeweler with magnifying glass and diamonds. Use as hero/split-screen background for login.
Minimalistic logo mark for the top navigation / header.

specific_instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure all generated components use .jsx or .js extension instead of .tsx since this is a JS project.
Carat values MUST be strictly formatted to 2 decimals everywhere (e.g., using Number(value).toFixed(2)).
All numeric columns (Weight, Pcs, Loss, Loss %) must be right-aligned and use 'tabular-nums' Tailwind class.
Implement an automated calculation effect in forms: e.g., Loss = Issue Weight - Return Weight; Loss % = (Loss / Issue Weight) * 100.
Print functionality for Jangad is CRITICAL. Create a specific print layout or @media print CSS to strip all UI chromes, navbars, and buttons, leaving only a crisp, readable slip with signature lines.
Never center align the app container. Left-align dense content, right-align numbers.
Install and use Phosphor icons (yarn add @phosphor-icons/react).
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Do not converge toward generic outputs. Use layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Do not apply universal transition (transition-all). Use specific transitions.
Never center align the App container in CSS (.App { text-align: center; } is banned).
Use modern button styles (pill or sharp).
Do not use placeholder image URLs. Use the provided image URLs.
Prioritize reusing existing components from src/components/ui.
Always add data-testid attributes to interactive and informational elements.
